prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — outlet (n.出路，出口): A creative adult finds an outlet for spare energy by making a wooden model at a workbench, idle hobby materials transformed into a finished project.
TOP RIGHT — creative (a.创造性的): An adult inventively transforms discarded cardboard and bottle caps into a small model boat, original design emerging on the workbench.
BOTTOM LEFT — handyman (n.手巧的人，能工巧匠): A capable handyman repairs a loose cabinet hinge with a screwdriver, neat toolbox nearby and confident practical posture.
BOTTOM RIGHT — resourceful (a.足智多谋的): An adult creatively uses a fallen sturdy branch as a walking support after a walking-stick breaks, solved practical problem.
review_notes: All cells visually reviewed. Outlet and creative accurately show hobby expression and inventive recycled boat with safe boundaries. Handyman and resourceful scenes are semantically accurate but top-of-head proximity to horizontal cut risks cropping; these cells superseded by repair-late-001.
